payload.entry: Verified forward alias + tip JSON. `bob capture-rewrite -c 10 --format json -- 'Buy milk \' => {"text":"Buy milk %","changed":true,"rule":"expand_sigil_alias","edits":[{"range":{"start":9,"end":10},"replacement":"%"}],"summary":"Typed % for \","alias":{"id":"directive_menu","key":"\","sigil":"%"}}. `bob capture-rewrite -c 10 --format json -- 'Buy milk %' => {"changed":false,"sigil_alias_tip":{"id":"directive_menu","sigil":"%","keys":["\"],"range":{"start":9,"end":10},"where":"after a word"}}. Literal probes: @cash\, @cash\, foo \\ all changed:false with explicit null tip. `x=25 %` gets no directive field from capture-complete here, so `x=25 \` stays literal (grammar decides). `- \` fires (-> `- %`); `- %` tip has no where phrase. Full workspace tests: only pre-existing base failures (see follow-ups).
